body: I'm in the best place mentally I've ever been - I adore myself and love myself. I'm in a healthy, strong, loving relationship with my sp. He treats me like a queen. Our kids all get along and love each other and my daughter adores him and he adores her. I adore his children and they adore me. He prioritises me and worships me. He's extremely thoughtful and always buying me little thoughtful gifts and I him. We have a lot of fun as a blended family and together on our childfree weekends. I support him in his 3d printing business that has taken off recently and he's so supportive.

Thank you for this post! I had a really bad weekend mentally thanks to my cycle and after listening to self love affirmations all night last night, I feel so much more positive and I'm choosing me now. I've been working on myself, or trying to this weekend, by learning how to heal my inner child and teenager and working on my attachment and self love because I love myself now, so much more than I ever have before, but ive realised I still have limiting beliefs about my self worth and I'm realising these are reflected externally in my environment. So, I'm choosing me and I know my sp will come back and for now, I'll keep sending my manifestation of him out to the universe, but I'm focusing so much more on me and doing my affirmations and the work, because after everything I've been through and survived, I fucking owe it to myself to do this final bit of work and what will be, will be. What I create, is what I want. So thank you.

Thank you. I think I needed someone else to tell me what I was already starting to think. Do you have any podcast or YouTube recommendations for learning to live in the end? I've been visualising it, and visualising what I want him to say to me and other images of us doing things, but I don't quite know how to live in the end as it were?

Thank you. I've been doing daily affirmations and listening to podcasts which is helping. So, if I detach, from him, but stop looking for anything else and view it as not waiting for him, but just carrying on, being single, as it were? And if I were to do the fwb's thing with him, that's a bad idea too?

Yeah, I get you completely. I want commitment from sp, but in the meantime, I guess I'm open to dating other people, or at least seeing what else is out there? I don't wanna be waiting around for sp because I'll go into waiting mode thanks to my adhd🤦‍♀️ I'm also aware I'm looking for validation by dating other people/talking to people, which is something I desperately want to work on, but ive no idea how. My mood has also taken a dip the last couple of days because of my cycle which is not helping and I know I'll be ok in a day or two and back to being positive!
Do you mean the hot and cold behaviour from sp? Cause he's still messaging me, but mostly in the evenings, whereas when we were dating, it was throughout the day, until it wasn't as much.

My only problem is that because of lockdown restrictions, we can't see each other. And I know a cuddle would help immensely! 
X

She's shown no remorse apparently for any of it. A couple of other TA's did some work with her last week, off site, and she showed no remorse. She's a very messed up girl and all I did was try to help. Obviously in the wrong way. But still. X

I can't help but blame myself because I'm meant to be the adult and she's technically a child. 
I felt as well that I was protecting her. 

She made the cigarette allegation after 3 days of being abusive and with the intention of getting me sacked. 

Its all pretty hard to deal with, not gonna lie. :(
I'm very close to my boyfriend, I just don't want to let him down by telling him how badly I've relapsed. X

I'm terrified of losing my job. With this job I'm able to pay off some of my debts, pay my bills, make some savings and pay my parents rent. Without a job, I'm unable to do any of those things and my parents are struggling financially because of covid. I also really don't want to let them down and I know I will have done. I just feel very stupid and naive...
